snippet.title: A Brat's Journey: A Rose Playing Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Also known in the short form as BJ: RPG. You control rosedoodle, the bratty catsprout who travels across Stardust Valley, a world filled with many friends and mascots. Travel to various areas seen in the Vchiban animated videos. Help your friends and gather many of the heavily inspired collectables in the game.

Video edited by Caerwyn Montale
@CaerwynMontale 

More information and game download can be found on the Evil Hive Website
https://evilhive.com/
